reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 discusses multi-component high-entropy alloy barriers for Cu/Si systems, not alumina barriers for Cr/Zr. E2 mentions challenges with Cr coatings (peeling/cracking) and the need for Al in ATF cladding design, but provides no specific evidence that an alumina interlayer solves interdiffusion or preserves corrosion resistance. The premises are therefore largely unsupported by the provided citations.
premises: Alumina (Al2O3) can act as an effective diffusion barrier between Cr and Zr.
The alumina interlayer will suppress formation of deleterious Cr-Zr intermetallic phases.
The alumina interlayer will not interfere with the corrosion resistance of the Cr coating under normal operating conditions.
The alumina interlayer will improve coating adhesion and structural integrity after high-temperature steam exposure.
